mapper.sql: select obs.id, obs.outbound_detail_id, obs.inbound_batch_id, obs.split_quantity, obs.remaining_quantity, obs.created_at from outbound_batch_split obs
mapper.select: where obs.inbound_batch_id = #{inboundBatchId} order by obs.created_at desc
select sum(split_quantity) as total_split_quantity, count(1) as split_count from outbound_batch_split where inbound_batch_id = #{inboundBatchId}

select obs.id, obs.outbound_detail_id, obs.inbound_batch_id, obs.split_quantity, obs.remaining_quantity, obs.created_at, ood.outbound_order_id, ood.material_id, ood.material_batch_id, ood.quantity as detail_quantity, oo.outbound_status, oo.outbound_type, oo.warehouse_id, oo.outbound_time from outbound_batch_split obs left join outbound_order_detail ood on obs.outbound_detail_id = ood.detail_id left join outbound_order oo on ood.outbound_order_id = oo.outbound_order_id where obs.inbound_batch_id = #{inboundBatchId} order by obs.created_at desc
